rationale: Same Ukrainska Pravda detail that the Krynky plan's frontage was about 30 km from the rail bridge to Krynky.
Both report the same 3–4 days for a 30 km strip from one article; B adds the three brigades and missing second echelon.
Same HUR figures for the Sergey Kotov: 7 dead, 6 wounded, 52 evacuated.
A walk of "more than 10 km" by evacuees and a 15 km total pipeline run are different measures.
HUR's claim of two Su-30SMs downed on 2 May 2025 is more specific than "at least one".
The Russian court's ~300 km is consistent with HUR sources' "over 200 km" for the same A-50 engagement.
Same modelled 26–27 Nov 2023 storm with 18.7 mm rain and 70–74 km/h gusts; B gives fuller detail.
Five killed in the 8 Oct 2022 bridge explosion is the same figure in B, which has more sources.
An OSM measurement of 10.5 km corroborates the reported ~10 km walk through the pipeline.
B's loss of 3 helicopters on the air bridge restates A's figure from the same sources.
Khartiia's ~200 encircled in Kupiansk on 12 Dec 2025 is restated within B's fuller report.
Same 173 evacuees reaching Zaporizhzhia on 8 May 2022, same source.
Same Achilles claim of blowing the Kupiansk pipeline with about 3 t on 13 Dec 2025.
Same CNN-sourced SBU footage of two Sea Babies hitting from opposite sides about five minutes apart.
Same launch of two Neptunes about 120 km out with about six minutes' flight; B gives fuller detail.
B gives HUR's revised 2 Jan 2025 claim (two Mi-8s destroyed plus one damaged), refining A.
Both report Russian infiltrators hiding in Kupiansk blocks in groups of 2–6, from the same article.
Both give about 2,500 Azovstal defenders captured, likely the same Ukrainian figure.
Same claim of demolishing the Kupiansk pipeline with about 3 t on 13 Dec 2025.
Same Oleshchuk report of no A-50s near the front for over a week; B adds the pilots' talk.
Same DeepState computation of 10,902 km² recaptured in September 2022; topic 07 is canonical.
Same claim that the Magura V5 is rated for sea state 2.
Both report 5–6 guard vessels at the Crimean Bridge in Dec 2024 from the same source, each adding other detail.
Same Russian claim of 1,026 marines surrendering at Illich on 13 Apr 2022.
Same Shoigu claim that Krynky was cleared with up to 3,500 Ukrainians killed.
Both describe three Magura V7s downing a Su-30SM off Novorossiysk on 2 May 2025, sharing the TWZ source.
Same FFM figure of 350–780 m between Oleshky shelterbelts; topic 06 is canonical.
Both report the Sergey Kotov sunk by five hits near Kerch on 5 Mar 2024, sharing sources.
B judges Russian HIMARS-interception claims, including the 44, unsupported by footage.
Girkin's "more than 30" vehicles lost falls within observers' 20–40 range for Vuhledar.
200–300 per bridgehead and 300–500 total on the left bank are estimates of different scope, not one quantity.
The 450 kg charge of the Sea Baby that hit Novorossiysk is restated in B, which has more sources.
Ukraine's ~12,000 km² and 500+ settlements fit Zaluzhnyi's "more than 10,000 km²" and ~500; both Ukrainian official figures.
The UK MoD's 30+ abandoned vehicles and Moscow Calling's 31 lost in one assault corroborate each other from opposite sides.
Same Russian MoD Moskva figures: 1 dead, 27 missing, 396 rescued.
The governor's over 3,000 km² for 6–11 Sep matches ISW's figure, which likely drew on Ukrainian statements.
Both describe Azovstal's stacks and 30–40 m power lines on the approach, from the same TIME article.
B's seven missions with 16 sorties restates A's seven missions with 16 helicopters.
Same Moscow court charge against Dzyaman for an S-200 kill at about 300 km.
An OSM measurement of 10.5 km corroborates the evacuees' walk of "more than 10 km".
